abstract: Upwork's 2023 Freelance Forward report examines trends in the freelance labor market, finding that writing freelancers experienced a 15% decline in job postings. The report identifies emerging signs of rate compression in translation and content categories, suggesting potential pricing pressures in these segments of the freelance economy.
keyFindings: Writing freelancers reported 15% fewer job postings in 2023 compared to the prior period
